blocks.title: What is the difference between a website and a web application?
blocks.text: A website is primarily informational — pages of content that users read. A web application is interactive software that users log into, take actions in, and receive personalised data from — such as a customer portal, SaaS dashboard, e-commerce platform, or booking system. Web apps require backend databases, authentication, and business logic layers.
